spans.s:
लुष् r. 1st and 10th cls. (लोषति लोषयति)
 1. To rob, to steal.
 2. To hurt,
to kill.

लूष् r. 1st cl. (लूषति) To adorn, to decorate. r. 10th cl. (लूषयति-ते)
 1.
To hurt, to injure.
 2. To steal, to rob.

लुषभ m. (-भः) An elephant in rut.
 E. रुष् to be enraged, Unādi aff.
अभच्, with लुष् substituted for the root, and the vowel unchanged.
